expr: (if listToNat l1 + listToNat l2 = 0 then [0] else Nat.digits 10 (listToNat l1 + listToNat l2))

lemmas.name: l2n
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l : List Nat), listToNat l = Nat.ofDigits 10 l
lemmas.proof:
by intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [listToNat, Nat.ofDigits]
  | cons a t ih => simp [listToNat, Nat.ofDigits_cons, ih]

lemmas.name: gl_cc
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a b : Nat) (t : List Nat), (a :: b :: t).getLast! = (b :: t).getLast!
lemmas.proof:
by intro a b t
  rw [List.getLast!_eq_getLast?_getD, List.getLast!_eq_getLast?_getD, List.getLast?_cons_cons]

lemmas.name: last_pos
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l : List Nat), l ≠ [] → l.getLast! ≠ 0 → 0 < listToNat l
lemmas.proof:
by intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro _ hl
    cases t with
    | nil => simp [listToNat] at hl ⊢; omega
    | cons b t' =>
      have hl' : (b :: t').getLast! ≠ 0 := by rw [gl_cc] at hl; exact hl
      have := ih (by simp) hl'
      simp only [listToNat] at this ⊢; omega

lemmas.name: digits_last
lemmas.proof:
by intro s hs
  have h := Nat.getLast_digit_ne_zero 10 hs
  have hne : Nat.digits 10 s ≠ [] := Nat.digits_ne_nil_iff_ne_zero.mpr hs
  rw [List.getLast!_eq_getLast?_getD, List.getLast?_eq_getLast_of_ne_nil hne]
  simpa using h

lemmas.name: add5
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l1 l2 : List Nat) (h : addTwoNumbers_precond l1 l2), addTwoNumbers_postcond l1 l2 (if listToNat l1 + listToNat l2 = 0 then [0] else Nat.digits 10 (listToNat l1 + listToNat l2)) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro l1 l2 h
  obtain ⟨hl1, hl2, hd1, hd2, hg1, hg2⟩ := h
  unfold addTwoNumbers_postcond
  by_cases hz : listToNat l1 + listToNat l2 = 0
  · rw [if_pos hz]
    refine ⟨by simp [listToNat, hz], by simp, Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_, rfl⟩⟩
    · rcases hg1 with hg | hg
      · have := last_pos l1 (by intro e; simp [e] at hl1) hg; omega
      · exact hg
    · rcases hg2 with hg | hg
      · have := last_pos l2 (by intro e; simp [e] at hl2) hg; omega
      · exact hg
  · rw [if_neg hz]
    refine ⟨?_, fun d hd => Nat.digits_lt_base (by norm_num) hd, Or.inl (digits_last _ hz)⟩
    rw [l2n (Nat.digits 10 _), Nat.ofDigits_digits]
